properties.site-address: Haydon Bridge Fire Station, Station Road, Haydon Road
properties.notes: Site of former fire station that has now closed and been demolished. Previously owned by NCC but sold to Bradley Homes for redevelopment, with permission now granted for a development of 5 homes (17/02577/FUL). Development is now underway and will be completed by 2020/21..
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
